'''Garrbo V'Droz's brother''' was the brother of renowned architect [[Garrbo V'Droz]]. He worked as a construction foreman. This green-haired [[Gender/Legends|man]] was involved in the construction of [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]]. After its completion, [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] killed him to prevent anyone else from learning about his hidden storehouse.<ref name="LCS">''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]''</ref>
